<h1 id="kubernetes-gateway-api-完全指南">Kubernetes Gateway API 完全指南</h1>
<h2 id="目录">目录</h2>
<ol>
<li><a href="#%E7%AE%80%E4%BB%8B" rel="noopener nofollow">简介</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E5%9F%BA%E7%A1%80%E6%A6%82%E5%BF%B5" rel="noopener nofollow">基础概念</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84%E5%8E%9F%E7%90%86" rel="noopener nofollow">架构原理</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E5%AE%9E%E8%B7%B5%E6%8C%87%E5%8D%97" rel="noopener nofollow">实践指南</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E6%9C%80%E4%BD%B3%E5%AE%9E%E8%B7%B5" rel="noopener nofollow">最佳实践</a></li>
<li><a href="#%E5%B8%B8%E8%A7%81%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%E4%B8%8E%E6%95%85%E9%9A%9C%E6%8E%92%E6%9F%A5" rel="noopener nofollow">常见问题与故障排查</a></li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="简介">简介</h2>
<p>Kubernetes Gateway API 是一个面向服务的、可扩展的 Kubernetes 流量管理标准,由 SIG-NETWORK 社区维护。它是 Ingress API 的演进版本,旨在解决 Ingress 在表达能力、扩展性和标准化方面的局限性。</p>
<h3 id="为什么需要-gateway-api">为什么需要 Gateway API?</h3>
<p><strong>传统 Ingress 的局限性:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>功能有限</strong>:仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS,缺乏对 TCP、UDP、gRPC 等协议的原生支持</li>
<li><strong>扩展性差</strong>:不同 Ingress Controller 使用不同的注解(annotation),导致配置不兼容</li>
<li><strong>表达能力弱</strong>:难以实现复杂的流量管理场景(如流量分割、镜像、高级路由匹配)</li>
<li><strong>角色分离不清</strong>:基础设施团队和应用团队的职责边界模糊</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Gateway API 的优势:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>角色导向</strong>:明确区分集群操作员、基础设施提供商和应用开发者的职责</li>
<li><strong>表达式丰富</strong>:支持更复杂的路由规则、流量管理和安全策略</li>
<li><strong>协议无关</strong>:原生支持 HTTP、HTTPS、TCP、UDP、gRPC、TLS 等多种协议</li>
<li><strong>标准化</strong>:通过 CRD(Custom Resource Definition)实现跨厂商的一致性</li>
<li><strong>可扩展</strong>:通过参数化配置支持厂商特定的扩展</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="基础概念">基础概念</h2>
<h3 id="核心资源对象">核心资源对象</h3>
<p>Gateway API 定义了一组相互关联的资源对象,每个对象都有明确的职责:</p>
<h4 id="1-gatewayclass-网关类">1. GatewayClass (网关类)</h4>
<p><strong>作用</strong>:定义网关的实现类型和配置模板,由基础设施提供商创建和管理。</p>
<p><strong>特点</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>集群级别资源(Cluster-scoped)</li>
<li>引用具体的 Gateway Controller 实现</li>
<li>一个集群可以有多个 GatewayClass(如 nginx、envoy、istio 等)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>示例</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: GatewayClass
metadata:
  name: nginx-gateway-class
spec:
  controllerName: gateway.networking.k8s.io/nginx-ingress-controller
</code></pre>
<h4 id="2-gateway-网关">2. Gateway (网关)</h4>
<p><strong>作用</strong>:表示实际的负载均衡器实例,定义监听器(Listeners)和网络端点。</p>
<p><strong>特点</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>命名空间级别资源(Namespace-scoped)</li>
<li>引用 GatewayClass 确定实现方式</li>
<li>配置监听端口、协议、TLS 证书等</li>
<li>由基础设施团队管理</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>示例</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: production-gateway
  namespace: web-app
spec:
  gatewayClassName: nginx-gateway-class
  listeners:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      protocol: HTTP
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: All
    - name: https
      port: 443
      protocol: HTTPS
      tls:
        mode: Terminate
        certificateRefs:
          - name: tls-secret
            kind: Secret
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: Same
</code></pre>
<h4 id="3-httproute-http-路由">3. HTTPRoute (HTTP 路由)</h4>
<p><strong>作用</strong>:定义如何将 HTTP/HTTPS 流量路由到后端服务,是最常用的路由类型。</p>
<p><strong>特点</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>支持基于路径、主机名、Header、Query 参数的路由规则</li>
<li>支持流量权重分配(流量分割)</li>
<li>支持请求/响应头修改</li>
<li>支持 URL 重写和重定向</li>
<li>由应用开发者管理</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>示例</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: web-app-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: production-gateway
      namespace: web-app
  hostnames:
    - "app.example.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /api
      backendRefs:
        - name: api-service
          port: 8080
          weight: 90
        - name: api-service-v2
          port: 8080
          weight: 10
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
      backendRefs:
        - name: web-service
          port: 80
</code></pre>
<h4 id="4-tcproute-tcp-路由">4. TCPRoute (TCP 路由)</h4>
<p><strong>作用</strong>:路由 TCP 流量到后端服务,适用于数据库、消息队列等场景。</p>
<p><strong>示例</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1alpha2
kind: TCPRoute
metadata:
  name: database-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: tcp-gateway
      namespace: default
  rules:
    - backendRefs:
        - name: backend
          port: 3000
</code></pre>
<h4 id="5-tlsroute-tls-路由">5. TLSRoute (TLS 路由)</h4>
<p><strong>作用</strong>:在 TLS 层面路由流量,支持 TLS Passthrough 模式。</p>
<p><strong>示例</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1alpha2
kind: TLSRoute
metadata:
  name: tls-passthrough-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: tls-gateway
  hostnames:
    - "secure.example.com"
  rules:
    - backendRefs:
        - name: secure-service
          port: 443
</code></pre>
<h4 id="6-udproute-udp-路由">6. UDPRoute (UDP 路由)</h4>
<p><strong>作用</strong>:路由 UDP 流量,适用于 DNS、游戏服务器等场景。</p>
<p><strong>示例</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1alpha2
kind: UDPRoute
metadata:
  name: dns-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: udp-gateway
  rules:
    - backendRefs:
        - name: dns-service
          port: 53
</code></pre>
<h4 id="7-grpcroute-grpc-路由">7. GRPCRoute (gRPC 路由)</h4>
<p><strong>作用</strong>:专门用于 gRPC 流量的路由,支持 gRPC 特有的元数据和方法匹配。</p>
<p><strong>示例</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: GRPCRoute
metadata:
  name: grpc-service-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: production-gateway
  hostnames:
    - "grpc.example.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - method:
            service: helloworld.Greeter
            method: SayHello
      backendRefs:
        - name: grpc-service
          port: 50051
</code></pre>
<h4 id="8-referencegrant-引用授权">8. ReferenceGrant (引用授权)</h4>
<p><strong>作用</strong>:跨命名空间引用的安全机制,允许一个命名空间的资源引用另一个命名空间的资源。</p>
<p><strong>示例</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: ReferenceGrant
metadata:
  name: allow-gateway-ref
  namespace: web-app
spec:
  from:
    - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
      kind: HTTPRoute
      namespace: default
  to:
    - group: ""
      kind: Secret
      name: tls-secret
</code></pre>
<h3 id="gateway-api-vs-ingress-对比">Gateway API vs Ingress 对比</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>特性</th>
<th>Ingress</th>
<th>Gateway API</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>API 成熟度</strong></td>
<td>Stable (v1)</td>
<td>Graduating to Standard (v1)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>协议支持</strong></td>
<td>HTTP/HTTPS</td>
<td>HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, gRPC, TLS</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>路由能力</strong></td>
<td>基于路径和主机</td>
<td>路径、主机、Header、Query、方法等</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>流量管理</strong></td>
<td>有限</td>
<td>权重分配、镜像、超时、重试</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>扩展机制</strong></td>
<td>注解(非标准)</td>
<td>参数化配置 + CRD</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>角色分离</strong></td>
<td>不明确</td>
<td>清晰的三层模型</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>跨命名空间</strong></td>
<td>不支持</td>
<td>通过 ReferenceGrant 支持</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>TLS 配置</strong></td>
<td>简单</td>
<td>灵活(Terminate/Passthrough)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>供应商兼容性</strong></td>
<td>差异大</td>
<td>标准化程度高</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2 id="架构原理">架构原理</h2>
<h3 id="整体架构">整体架构</h3>
<p>Gateway API 遵循 Kubernetes 的标准控制器模式,采用声明式 API 设计:</p>
<pre><code>用户/开发者 → Kubernetes API Server → Gateway Controller → Data Plane
     ↓              ↓                        ↓                  ↓
  创建资源      存储CRD资源            监听变化并生成配置    代理处理流量
</code></pre>
<h3 id="工作机制详解">工作机制详解</h3>
<h4 id="1-资源生命周期">1. 资源生命周期</h4>
<p><strong>创建阶段</strong>:</p>
<ol>
<li>用户通过 kubectl apply 创建 Gateway API 资源</li>
<li>API Server 验证资源格式并存储到 etcd</li>
<li>Gateway Controller 通过 Watch 机制检测到新资源</li>
<li>Controller 验证资源的语义正确性</li>
<li>Controller 将配置转换为数据平面的具体配置</li>
<li>Controller 更新资源的 Status 字段,反映配置状态</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>运行阶段</strong>:</p>
<ol>
<li>数据平面(如 Envoy)加载最新配置</li>
<li>客户端请求到达负载均衡器</li>
<li>数据平面根据路由规则匹配请求</li>
<li>请求被转发到相应的后端服务</li>
<li>响应返回给客户端</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>更新阶段</strong>:</p>
<ol>
<li>用户修改资源配置</li>
<li>Controller 检测到变更</li>
<li>重新计算配置并推送到数据平面</li>
<li>数据平面热重载配置(无中断)</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="2-控制平面与数据平面交互">2. 控制平面与数据平面交互</h4>
<p><strong>控制平面组件</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Gateway Controller</strong>:核心控制器,负责资源协调</li>
<li><strong>Configuration Generator</strong>:将 Gateway API 资源转换为代理特定配置</li>
<li><strong>Status Updater</strong>:更新资源状态,提供可观测性</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>数据平面组件</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Proxy</strong>:实际的流量处理引擎(Envoy/Nginx/HAProxy 等)</li>
<li><strong>Config Listener</strong>:监听配置变化并应用</li>
<li><strong>Metrics Exporter</strong>:导出监控指标</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="3-状态反馈机制">3. 状态反馈机制</h4>
<p>Gateway API 强调可观测性,每个资源都有详细的 Status 字段:</p>
<p><strong>Gateway Status 示例</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">status:
  conditions:
    - type: Accepted
      status: "True"
      reason: Accepted
      message: Gateway successfully accepted
    - type: Programmed
      status: "True"
      reason: Programmed
      message: Configuration programmed to data plane
  listeners:
    - name: http
      attachedRoutes: 5
      conditions:
        - type: Ready
          status: "True"
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="实践指南">实践指南</h2>
<h3 id="环境准备">环境准备</h3>
<p><strong>前置要求</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>Kubernetes 集群 (v1.22+)</li>
<li>kubectl 命令行工具</li>
<li>Helm v3 (可选,用于简化安装)</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="步骤-1-部署-metallb">步骤 1: 部署 metallb</h3>
<p>自建集群没有LB所以需要一个负载</p>
<h4 id="下载部署">下载部署</h4>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># 下载应用包
wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/metallb/metallb/v0.15.3/config/manifests/metallb-native.yaml

# 修改镜像地址
# 自行找代理
sed -i "s#quay.io#quay.chenby.cn#g" metallb-native.yaml 
cat metallb-native.yaml | grep image
        image: quay.chenby.cn/metallb/controller:v0.14.5
        image: quay.chenby.cn/metallb/speaker:v0.14.5
        
# 执行部署
kubectl apply -f metallb-native.yaml

# 可以连接国际网络
# kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/metallb/metallb/v0.15.3/config/manifests/metallb-native.yaml
</code></pre>
<h4 id="查看运行情况">查看运行情况</h4>
<pre><code class="language-shell">cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ kubectl -n metallb-system get all
NAME                             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
pod/controller-9c6cff498-h7khm   1/1     Running   0          45m
pod/speaker-kp5wl                1/1     Running   0          45m

NAME                              TYPE        CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)   AGE
service/metallb-webhook-service   ClusterIP   10.68.104.187   &lt;none&gt;        443/TCP   45m

NAME                     DESIRED   CURRENT   READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   NODE SELECTOR            AGE
daemonset.apps/speaker   1         1         1       1            1           kubernetes.io/os=linux   45m

NAME                         READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   AGE
deployment.apps/controller   1/1     1            1           45m

NAME                                   DESIRED   CURRENT   READY   AGE
replicaset.apps/controller-9c6cff498   1         1         1       45m
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$
</code></pre>
<h4 id="配置vip的资源池">配置VIP的资源池</h4>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># 新版本metallb使用了CR（Custom Resources），这里我们通过IPAddressPool的CR，进行地址池的定义。
# 如果实例中不设置IPAddressPool选择器L2Advertisement；那么L2Advertisement默认为该实例所有的IPAddressPool相关联。

cat &gt; metallb-config-ipaddresspool.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF
apiVersion: metallb.io/v1beta1
kind: IPAddressPool
metadata:
  name: first-pool
  namespace: metallb-system
spec:
  addresses:
  - 192.168.1.15-192.168.1.19
EOF

# 进行L2关联地址池的绑定。

cat &gt; metallb-config-L2Advertisement.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF
apiVersion: metallb.io/v1beta1
kind: L2Advertisement
metadata:
  name: example
  namespace: metallb-system
spec:
  ipAddressPools:
  - first-pool
EOF

# 执行部署
kubectl apply -f metallb-config-ipaddresspool.yaml
kubectl apply -f metallb-config-L2Advertisement.yaml
</code></pre>
<h3 id="步骤-2-安装-envoy-gateway">步骤 2: 安装 Envoy Gateway</h3>
<h4 id="执行部署">执行部署</h4>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># https://gateway.envoyproxy.io/docs/install/install-helm/
# 安装网关 API CRD 和 Envoy 网关
helm install eg oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/gateway-helm --version v1.7.3 -n envoy-gateway-system --create-namespace
</code></pre>
<h4 id="创建测试应用">创建测试应用</h4>
<pre><code class="language-shell">kubectl apply -f https://github.com/envoyproxy/gateway/releases/download/v1.7.3/quickstart.yaml -n default

# 查看访问地址
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ kubectl get svc -n envoy-gateway-system
NAME                        TYPE           CLUSTER-IP     EXTERNAL-IP    PORT(S)                                            AGE
envoy-default-eg-e41e7b31   LoadBalancer   10.68.120.80   192.168.1.15   80:32116/TCP                                       6s
envoy-gateway               ClusterIP      10.68.64.83    &lt;none&gt;         18000/TCP,18001/TCP,18002/TCP,19001/TCP,9443/TCP   30m
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$
</code></pre>
<h4 id="测试访问">测试访问</h4>
<pre><code class="language-shell">cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ curl --verbose --header "Host: www.example.com" http://192.168.1.15/get

<p>其他可选实现:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Envoy Gateway</strong>: Envoy 官方实现</li>
<li><strong>Istio</strong>: 服务网格方案</li>
<li><strong>Contour</strong>: VMware 维护的 Envoy 控制器</li>
<li><strong>Kong</strong>: Kong Ingress Controller</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="步骤-3-创建-gatewayclass">步骤 3: 创建 GatewayClass</h3>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">cat &gt; gatewayclass.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF 
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: GatewayClass
metadata:
  name: nginx-gateway-class
spec:
  controllerName: gateway.envoyproxy.io/gatewayclass-controller
EOF
</code></pre>
<p>应用配置:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl apply -f gatewayclass.yaml
kubectl get gatewayclass

cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ kubectl get gatewayclass
gatewayclass.gateway.networking.k8s.io/nginx-gateway-class created
NAME                  CONTROLLER                                      ACCEPTED   AGE
eg                    gateway.envoyproxy.io/gatewayclass-controller   True       19m
nginx-gateway-class   gateway.envoyproxy.io/gatewayclass-controller   True       18s
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ 
</code></pre>
<h3 id="步骤-4-部署示例应用">步骤 4: 部署示例应用</h3>
<p>创建两个简单的后端服务用于测试:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">cat &gt; demo-app.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web-app-v1
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-app-v1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web-app-v1
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web-app-v1
        image: registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/chenby/cby:nginx-v1
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web-app-v2
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-app-v2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web-app-v2
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web-app-v2
        image: registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/chenby/cby:nginx-v2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  labels:
    app: web-app-v2
  name: web-app-v2
spec:
  selector:
    app: web-app-v2
  ports:
  - port: 80
    protocol: TCP
    targetPort: 80
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  labels:
    app: web-app-v1
  name: web-app-v1
spec:
  selector:
    app: web-app-v1
  ports:
  - port: 80
    protocol: TCP
    targetPort: 80
EOF
</code></pre>
<p>同样创建 v2 版本,然后应用:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl apply -f demo-app.yaml
</code></pre>

<h3 id="步骤-5-配置基本-http-路由">步骤 5: 配置基本 HTTP 路由</h3>
<p>首先创建 Gateway:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">cat &gt; gateway.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF 
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: production-gateway
  namespace: web-app
spec:
  gatewayClassName: nginx-gateway-class
  listeners:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      protocol: HTTP
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: All
EOF
</code></pre>
<p>创建 HTTPRoute:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">cat &gt; httproute-basic.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF 
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: web-app-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: production-gateway
      namespace: web-app
  hostnames:
    - "app.example.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
      backendRefs:
        - name: web-app-v1
          port: 80
        - name: web-app-v2
          port: 80
EOF
</code></pre>
<p>应用配置:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl create namespace web-app
kubectl apply -f gateway.yaml
kubectl apply -f httproute-basic.yaml

# 验证
kubectl get gateway -n web-app
kubectl get httproute -n default

cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ kubectl get gateway -n web-app
NAME                 CLASS                 ADDRESS        PROGRAMMED   AGE
production-gateway   nginx-gateway-class   192.168.1.16   True         13s
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ 
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ kubectl get httproute -n default
NAME            HOSTNAMES             AGE
backend         ["www.example.com"]   26m
web-app-route   ["app.example.com"]   56s
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ 
</code></pre>
<p>获取 LoadBalancer IP 并测试:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl -H "Host: app.example.com" http://192.168.1.16

<h3 id="步骤-6-配置-tls-终止">步骤 6: 配置 TLS 终止</h3>
<h4 id="61-创建自签名证书测试用">6.1 创建自签名证书(测试用)</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openssl genrsa -out tls.key 2048
openssl req -new -key tls.key -out tls.csr -subj "/CN=app.example.com"
openssl x509 -req -in tls.csr -signkey tls.key -out tls.crt -days 365

kubectl create secret tls app-tls-secret \
  --cert=tls.crt \
  --key=tls.key \
  -n web-app

rm tls.key tls.csr tls.crt
</code></pre>
<h4 id="62-更新-gateway-配置启用-https">6.2 更新 Gateway 配置启用 HTTPS</h4>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">cat &gt; gateway-with-tls.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF 
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: production-gateway
  namespace: web-app
spec:
  gatewayClassName: nginx-gateway-class
  listeners:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      protocol: HTTP
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: All
    - name: https
      port: 443
      protocol: HTTPS
      tls:
        mode: Terminate
        certificateRefs:
          - name: app-tls-secret
            kind: Secret
            group: ""
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: All
EOF
</code></pre>
<p>应用更新:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl apply -f gateway-with-tls.yaml
</code></pre>
<p>测试 HTTPS 访问:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl -k -H "Host: app.example.com" https://192.168.1.16

&lt;h1 style="color: #2196F3;"&gt;Hello V2&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;时间：2026-05-11 星期一&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;地点：内蒙古自治区 呼和浩特市&lt;/p&gt;

<h3 id="步骤-7-配置流量分割金丝雀发布">步骤 7: 配置流量分割(金丝雀发布)</h3>
<p>创建将 90% 流量发送到 v1,10% 流量发送到 v2 的路由:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">cat &gt; httproute-canary.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF 
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: web-app-canary-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: production-gateway
      namespace: web-app
  hostnames:
    - "app.example.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
      backendRefs:
        - name: web-app-v1
          port: 80
          weight: 90
        - name: web-app-v2
          port: 80
          weight: 10
EOF
</code></pre>
<p>应用配置:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl delete -f httproute-basic.yaml
kubectl apply -f httproute-canary.yaml

cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ kubectl get HTTPRoute
NAMESPACE   NAME                   HOSTNAMES             AGE
default     backend                ["www.example.com"]   45m
default     web-app-canary-route   ["app.example.com"]   104s
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$
</code></pre>
<p>测试流量分割:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">for i in {1..20}; do
  curl -s -H "Host: app.example.com" http://192.168.1.16 
done

<h3 id="步骤-8-高级路由配置">步骤 8: 高级路由配置</h3>
<h4 id="81-基于-header-的路由">8.1 基于 Header 的路由</h4>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">cat &gt; httproute-header.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF 
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: header-based-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: production-gateway
      namespace: web-app
  hostnames:
    - "app.example.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - headers:
            - name: x-version
              value: v2
      backendRefs:
        - name: web-app-v2
          port: 80
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
      backendRefs:
        - name: web-app-v1
          port: 80
EOF
</code></pre>
<p>测试:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl delete -f httproute-canary.yaml
kubectl apply -f httproute-header.yaml

# 不带 Header,访问 v1
curl -H "Host: app.example.com" http://192.168.1.16

# 带 Header,访问 v2
curl -H "Host: app.example.com" -H "x-version: v2" http://192.168.1.16


cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ curl -H "Host: app.example.com" http://192.168.1.16
&lt;h1 style="color: #4CAF50;"&gt;Hello V1&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;时间：2026-05-11 星期一&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;地点：内蒙古自治区 呼和浩特市&lt;/p&gt;
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ 
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ curl -H "Host: app.example.com" -H "x-version: v2" http://192.168.1.16
&lt;h1 style="color: #2196F3;"&gt;Hello V2&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;时间：2026-05-11 星期一&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;地点：内蒙古自治区 呼和浩特市&lt;/p&gt;
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ 
</code></pre>
<h4 id="82-url-重写">8.2 URL 重写</h4>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">cat &gt; httproute-rewrite.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF 
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: rewrite-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: production-gateway
      namespace: web-app
  hostnames:
    - "app.example.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /api/v1
      filters:
        - type: URLRewrite
          urlRewrite:
            path:
              type: ReplacePrefixMatch
              replacePrefixMatch: /
      backendRefs:
        - name: web-app-v1
          port: 80
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /api/v2
      filters:
        - type: URLRewrite
          urlRewrite:
            path:
              type: ReplacePrefixMatch
              replacePrefixMatch: /
      backendRefs:
        - name: web-app-v2
          port: 80
EOF
</code></pre>
<p>测试使用</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl delete -f httproute-header.yaml
kubectl apply -f httproute-rewrite.yaml

curl -H "Host: app.example.com" http://192.168.1.16/api/v1
curl -H "Host: app.example.com" http://192.168.1.16/api/v2

cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ curl -H "Host: app.example.com" http://192.168.1.16/api/v1
&lt;h1 style="color: #4CAF50;"&gt;Hello V1&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;时间：2026-05-11 星期一&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;地点：内蒙古自治区 呼和浩特市&lt;/p&gt;
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ curl -H "Host: app.example.com" http://192.168.1.16/api/v2
&lt;h1 style="color: #2196F3;"&gt;Hello V2&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;时间：2026-05-11 星期一&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;地点：内蒙古自治区 呼和浩特市&lt;/p&gt;
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ 
</code></pre>
<h4 id="83-请求响应头修改">8.3 请求/响应头修改</h4>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">cat &gt; httproute-modify.yaml &lt;&lt; EOF 
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: header-modify-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: production-gateway
      namespace: web-app
  hostnames:
    - "app.example.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
      filters:
        - type: RequestHeaderModifier
          requestHeaderModifier:
            add:
              - name: X-Forwarded-Gateway
                value: "nginx-gateway"
            set:
              - name: X-Custom-Header
                value: "custom-value"
        - type: ResponseHeaderModifier
          responseHeaderModifier:
            add:
              - name: X-Powered-By
                value: "Gateway-API"
      backendRefs:
        - name: web-app-v1
          port: 80
EOF
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl delete -f httproute-rewrite.yaml
kubectl apply -f httproute-modify.yaml

curl -v -H "Host: app.example.com" http://192.168.1.16/

cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$ curl -v -H "Host: app.example.com" http://192.168.1.16/
*   Trying 192.168.1.16:80...
* Established connection to 192.168.1.16 (192.168.1.16 port 80) from 172.30.72.41 port 46798 
* using HTTP/1.x
&gt; GET / HTTP/1.1
&gt; Host: app.example.com
&gt; User-Agent: curl/8.18.0
&gt; Accept: */*
&gt; 
* Request completely sent off
&lt; HTTP/1.1 200 OK
&lt; server: nginx/1.29.8
&lt; date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:54:24 GMT
&lt; content-type: text/html
&lt; content-length: 128
&lt; last-modified: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:02:13 GMT
&lt; etag: "6a01e165-80"
&lt; accept-ranges: bytes
&lt; x-powered-by: Gateway-API
&lt; 
&lt;h1 style="color: #4CAF50;"&gt;Hello V1&lt;/h1&gt;&lt;p&gt;时间：2026-05-11 星期一&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;地点：内蒙古自治区 呼和浩特市&lt;/p&gt;
* Connection #0 to host 192.168.1.16:80 left intact
cby@DESKTOP-IKRNJQE:~$
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="最佳实践">最佳实践</h2>
<h3 id="1-安全管理">1. 安全管理</h3>
<h4 id="11-使用-rbac-限制权限">1.1 使用 RBAC 限制权限</h4>
<p>为应用团队创建受限角色,只允许管理 Route 资源:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: gateway-route-manager
  namespace: default
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["gateway.networking.k8s.io"]
    resources: ["httproutes", "grpcroutes"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "update", "patch"]
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-使用-referencegrant-控制跨命名空间访问">1.2 使用 ReferenceGrant 控制跨命名空间访问</h4>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: ReferenceGrant
metadata:
  name: allow-tls-ref
  namespace: cert-manager
spec:
  from:
    - group: gateway.networking.k8s.io
      kind: Gateway
      namespace: web-app
  to:
    - group: ""
      kind: Secret
      name: wildcard-tls-cert
</code></pre>
<h4 id="13-tls-最佳实践">1.3 TLS 最佳实践</h4>
<ul>
<li>使用通配符证书减少证书管理复杂度</li>
<li>定期轮换证书,建议使用 cert-manager 自动化</li>
<li>优先使用 TLS Terminate 模式</li>
<li>强制 HTTPS,配置 HTTP 到 HTTPS 重定向</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="2-性能优化">2. 性能优化</h3>
<h4 id="21-合理配置监听器">2.1 合理配置监听器</h4>
<p>限制允许的路由来源,减少配置复杂度:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">spec:
  listeners:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      protocol: HTTP
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: Selector
          selector:
            matchLabels:
              allow-gateway-access: "true"
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-避免过度复杂的路由规则">2.2 避免过度复杂的路由规则</h4>
<ul>
<li>合并相似的路由规则,减少配置数量</li>
<li>使用最具体的匹配条件优先,提高匹配效率</li>
<li>避免过多的 Header/Query 匹配,影响性能</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="3-可靠性保障">3. 可靠性保障</h3>
<h4 id="31-渐进式发布策略">3.1 渐进式发布策略</h4>
<p><strong>金丝雀发布流程</strong>:</p>
<ol>
<li>部署新版本服务(v2)</li>
<li>配置 5% 流量到 v2</li>
<li>监控错误率和延迟</li>
<li>逐步增加流量比例(10% → 25% → 50% → 100%)</li>
<li>确认稳定后,移除旧版本</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># 阶段 1: 5% 流量
backendRefs:
  - name: web-app-v1
    weight: 95
  - name: web-app-v2
    weight: 5

# 阶段 2: 25% 流量
backendRefs:
  - name: web-app-v1
    weight: 75
  - name: web-app-v2
    weight: 25

# 阶段 3: 100% 流量
backendRefs:
  - name: web-app-v2
    weight: 100
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-蓝绿部署">3.2 蓝绿部署</h4>
<p>通过快速切换权重实现蓝绿部署:</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># 初始状态: 100% 蓝色环境
backendRefs:
  - name: blue-service
    weight: 100
  - name: green-service
    weight: 0

# 切换时: 快速切换到绿色环境
backendRefs:
  - name: blue-service
    weight: 0
  - name: green-service
    weight: 100
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-多租户隔离">4. 多租户隔离</h3>
<h4 id="41-命名空间隔离策略">4.1 命名空间隔离策略</h4>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">spec:
  listeners:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      protocol: HTTP
      allowedRoutes:
        namespaces:
          from: Selector
          selector:
            matchLabels:
              environment: production
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-调试和故障排查">5. 调试和故障排查</h3>
<h4 id="51-常见问题诊断清单">5.1 常见问题诊断清单</h4>
<p><strong>问题 1: Gateway 状态为 "Not Accepted"</strong></p>
<p>检查步骤:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 1. 检查 GatewayClass 是否存在且有效
kubectl get gatewayclass

# 2. 检查 Controller 是否运行
kubectl get pods -n &lt;controller-namespace&gt;

# 3. 查看 Gateway 事件
kubectl describe gateway &lt;name&gt; -n &lt;namespace&gt;

# 4. 检查控制器日志
kubectl logs -n &lt;controller-namespace&gt; -l app=&lt;controller-name&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题 2: HTTPRoute 未被接受</strong></p>
<p>检查步骤:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 1. 验证 parentRefs 是否正确
kubectl get httproute &lt;name&gt; -o yaml

# 2. 检查 Gateway 是否允许该命名空间的路由
kubectl describe gateway &lt;gateway-name&gt; -n &lt;namespace&gt;

# 3. 验证后端服务是否存在
kubectl get svc &lt;backend-service-name&gt;

# 4. 检查 ReferenceGrant (如果跨命名空间)
kubectl get referencegrant -A
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题 3: 流量未正确路由</strong></p>
<p>检查步骤:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 1. 验证路由规则匹配条件
kubectl describe httproute &lt;name&gt;

# 2. 测试后端服务直接访问
kubectl run test --rm -i --tty --image=curlimages/curl -- \
  curl http://&lt;service-name&gt;.&lt;namespace&gt;.svc.cluster.local

# 3. 检查 Gateway 外部 IP
kubectl get gateway &lt;name&gt; -o jsonpath='{.status.addresses}'

# 4. 使用详细输出测试
curl -v -H "Host: &lt;hostname&gt;" http://&lt;gateway-ip&gt;&lt;path&gt;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="6-生产环境建议">6. 生产环境建议</h3>
<h4 id="61-高可用架构">6.1 高可用架构</h4>
<ul>
<li>部署多个 Controller 副本实现控制器高可用</li>
<li>使用多个 Gateway 实例分散负载</li>
<li>配置跨区域部署提高灾难恢复能力</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
</code></pre>
<h4 id="62-备份和恢复">6.2 备份和恢复</h4>
<ul>
<li>定期备份 Gateway API 资源配置</li>
<li>使用 GitOps 工具(如 ArgoCD、Flux)管理配置</li>
<li>建立配置变更审批流程</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 备份所有 Gateway API 资源
kubectl get gatewayclass,gateway,httproute,tcproute,referencegrant -A -o yaml &gt; gateway-backup.yaml
</code></pre>
<h4 id="63-容量规划">6.3 容量规划</h4>
<p>关键监控指标:</p>
<ul>
<li>每秒请求数 (RPS)</li>
<li>平均/ P95/P99 延迟</li>
<li>错误率 (4xx, 5xx)</li>
<li>活跃连接数</li>
<li>带宽使用率</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="64-版本升级策略">6.4 版本升级策略</h4>
<ul>
<li>先在测试环境验证新版本</li>
<li>阅读发行说明,了解破坏性变更</li>
<li>灰度升级,先升级部分节点</li>
<li>保留回滚方案</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="7-常见应用场景">7. 常见应用场景</h3>
<h4 id="场景-1-多域名托管">场景 1: 多域名托管</h4>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: multi-domain-route
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: production-gateway
  hostnames:
    - "app1.example.com"
    - "app2.example.com"
    - "app3.example.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
      backendRefs:
        - name: shared-backend
          port: 80
</code></pre>
<h4 id="场景-2-api-网关">场景 2: API 网关</h4>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: api-gateway-route
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: production-gateway
  hostnames:
    - "api.example.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /users
      backendRefs:
        - name: user-service
          port: 8080
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /orders
      backendRefs:
        - name: order-service
          port: 8080
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /payments
      backendRefs:
        - name: payment-service
          port: 8080
</code></pre>
<h4 id="场景-3-ab-测试">场景 3: A/B 测试</h4>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: ab-test-route
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: production-gateway
  hostnames:
    - "app.example.com"
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
      backendRefs:
        - name: variant-a
          port: 80
          weight: 50
        - name: variant-b
          port: 80
          weight: 50
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="常见问题与故障排查">常见问题与故障排查</h2>
<h3 id="faq">FAQ</h3>
<p><strong>Q1: Gateway API 和 Ingress 可以共存吗?</strong></p>
<p>A: 可以。它们使用不同的资源类型,可以同时在集群中运行。建议逐步迁移,先在新服务中使用 Gateway API。</p>
<p><strong>Q2: 如何选择 Gateway Controller 实现?</strong></p>
<p>A: 考虑因素:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>功能需求</strong>:是否需要 gRPC、TCP 等高级功能</li>
<li><strong>性能要求</strong>:吞吐量、延迟指标</li>
<li><strong>生态系统</strong>:与现有工具链的集成</li>
<li><strong>社区活跃度</strong>:维护频率、问题响应速度</li>
<li><strong>企业支持</strong>:是否需要商业支持</li>
</ul>
<p>推荐选择:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>通用场景</strong>: Envoy Gateway、NGINX Gateway Fabric</li>
<li><strong>服务网格</strong>: Istio</li>
<li><strong>高性能</strong>: Envoy Gateway</li>
<li><strong>简单易用</strong>: Contour</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Q3: Gateway API 的性能如何?</strong></p>
<p>A: Gateway API 本身是控制平面,性能取决于数据平面实现(Envoy/Nginx 等)、配置复杂度和硬件资源。现代实现(如 Envoy)可以达到数十万 QPS,延迟在毫秒级。</p>
<p><strong>Q4: 如何处理 WebSocket 连接?</strong></p>
<p>A: HTTPRoute 天然支持 WebSocket,无需特殊配置。确保后端服务正确处理 Upgrade 头即可。</p>
<p><strong>Q5: 可以实现速率限制吗?</strong></p>
<p>A: Gateway API v1 标准不直接支持速率限制,但可以通过以下方式实现:</p>
<ul>
<li>Controller 特定扩展(如 Envoy Gateway 的 RateLimitFilter)</li>
<li>在服务网格层实现(Istio)</li>
<li>使用外部速率限制服务</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Q6: 如何迁移现有的 Ingress 配置?</strong></p>
<p>A: 迁移步骤:</p>
<ol>
<li>分析现有 Ingress 资源</li>
<li>映射 Ingress 规则到 HTTPRoute</li>
<li>创建对应的 Gateway 资源</li>
<li>测试新配置</li>
<li>逐步切换流量</li>
<li>删除旧 Ingress 资源</li>
</ol>
<p>可以使用官方工具 <code>ingress2gateway</code> 辅助转换:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">kubectl get ingress -A -o yaml | ingress2gateway -f -
</code></pre>
<p><strong>Q7: Gateway API 支持哪些 Kubernetes 版本?</strong></p>
<p>A: Gateway API v1 需要 Kubernetes 1.22+,推荐使用最新的稳定版 Kubernetes 以获得最佳支持。</p>
<p><strong>Q8: 如何实现灰度发布的自动化?</strong></p>
<p>A: 结合以下工具:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Argo Rollouts</strong>:渐进式交付</li>
<li><strong>Flagger</strong>:自动化的金丝雀分析</li>
<li><strong>自定义控制器</strong>:根据监控指标自动调整权重</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="总结">总结</h3>
<p>Kubernetes Gateway API 代表了 Kubernetes 流量管理的未来方向。通过本教程,您应该已经掌握了:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>核心概念</strong>:理解了 GatewayClass、Gateway、HTTPRoute 等资源的作用和关系</li>
<li><strong>架构原理</strong>:了解了控制平面和数据平面的交互机制</li>
<li><strong>实践能力</strong>:能够从零搭建 Gateway API 环境并配置各种路由场景</li>
<li><strong>最佳实践</strong>:学会了安全管理、性能优化、可靠性保障等生产环境技巧</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>下一步学习建议</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>深入研究特定 Gateway Controller 的文档</li>
<li>探索服务网格与 Gateway API 的集成</li>
<li>学习 GitOps 工作流管理 Gateway 配置</li>
</ul>
<p>祝您在 Kubernetes Gateway API 的学习之路上取得成功!</p>
